purpose: personal account of the Terraform incident that deleted DataTalks.Club production infrastructure and the recovery

required_facts.fact: The intended migration moved AI Shipping Labs from GitHub Pages to AWS, then planned a Django deployment on a subdomain before switching the main domain.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 1-10: migration sequence is listed.

required_facts.fact: The existing Terraform setup was reused to save roughly $5–10 per month, mixing the new site with the DataTalks.Club platform infrastructure.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 41-47: reuse decision, savings, and increased risk are described.

required_facts.fact: Terraform state remained on an old computer, so the plan treated existing infrastructure as absent and began creating resources.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 49-57: missing state and warning sign are described.

required_facts.fact: Claude Code was asked to remove duplicate resources, then ran terraform destroy after the old state archive replaced the current state.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 59-71 and 82-86: cleanup, state replacement, and destroy sequence are stated.

required_facts.fact: The destroy removed the production VPC, RDS database, ECS cluster, load balancers, and bastion host.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 73-80: destroyed infrastructure and outage are described.

required_facts.fact: AWS snapshots were initially absent from the console, but AWS Support found one on its side after Alexey upgraded to Business Support.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 90-118: backup search, support upgrade, and hidden snapshot are described.

required_facts.fact: The database snapshot was restored exactly 24 hours after deletion.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 132-141: restoration timing and visibility are stated.

required_facts.fact: The restored courses_answer table contained 1,943,200 rows and the course platform came back online.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 146-166: data check and recovery are described.

required_facts.fact: After recovery, Terraform plans were reviewed manually and commands were run by Alexey rather than automatically by the agent.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 148-156: changed execution process is stated.

required_facts.fact: Preventive measures included external S3 backups, deletion protection, a daily restore workflow, and moving Terraform state to S3.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 168-228: safeguards and state migration are described.

author_attribution: Attribute the incident, mistakes, recovery, and safeguards to Alexey; preserve the uncertainty before AWS found the snapshot and the full-recovery timing.
